parameters.name: CodeVersions
parameters.description: The list of percentage-based canary release version configurations. A maximum of two versions are supported, and the total percentage must equal 100.

sub_parameters.name: Percentage
sub_parameters.description: The canary release percentage for the code version. Valid values: 1 to 100.

parameters.name: Env
parameters.description:
The environment name.  
Valid values:
- `staging`: staging environment 
- `production`: production environment

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The name of the Edge Function Routine.

parameters.name: Strategy
parameters.description:
The deployment strategy.  
Valid values:
- `percentage`: percentage mode
